messages:
maria_cs: Morning — quick capacity pulse for Cinder reserved pool (weekly check-in). GPU hours: 5,200 this week (-9% w/w). Peak saturation 88% (Tue 15:10) with queue depth spikes to 14. Not a full outage but noticeable queueing.
johnathan_ops: Noted. Where did the queue build — onboarding or production?
maria_cs: Mostly onboarding + a nightly batch rerun from cinder-training. Tail from queue monitor pasted below:
````
pool: reserved-cinder
t=2026-03-18T15:10Z sat=88% q=14 pending_hours=1.4
t=2026-03-18T15:20Z sat=82% q=9 pending_hours=0.9
```
kevin_infra: Any error rate or latency changes during that window?
maria_cs: Small error bump — 0.7% 4xx/5xx (was 0.2%). Latency p95 rose from ~420ms -> ~610ms during the spike. Looks like one tenant exceeded concurrency and flooded the pool.
sophie_se: I throttled their canary to 2 concurrent workers at 16:05 and the queue started to clear. @maria_cs did CS notify the Cinder eng lead?
maria_cs: Yep — messaged them at 16:25: "please reduce concurrent training workers to 2 while we validate autoscaler behavior". They confirmed and scheduled a fix.
deploy-bot: release: autoscaler v1.8 rolled at 2026-03-18T14:50Z (no failures reported).
jonathan_ops: Good. Any sign this could impact renewal conversations? Accounts flagged Cinder earlier for lower utilization.
maria_cs: Renewal risk low for now. They value reserved hours but want clearer onboarding docs and a short deep-dive on autoscaler decisions.
sophie_se: Action: schedule 30-min deep-dive with Cinder Eng (owner: sophie_se). Deadline: Fri EOD.
kevin_infra: I'll add a temporary pool rule to avoid single-tenant >65% saturation for >30m. Will announce when live.
maria_cs: Update runbook: alert if p95 latency >500ms OR saturation >80% for 15m -> notify #eng-oncall + #customer-success.
jonathan_ops: Can we estimate cost impact if they staggered jobs?
maria_cs: Quick ballpark: avoiding the burst saves ~7% of extra GPU-hours — ~360 GPU-hours/month -> ~\u0024~11k/month saved for them (rough).
sophie_se: I'll include that number in the customer follow-up.
maria_cs: TL;DR: weekly dedicated capacity pulse for Cinder: utilization slightly down, one onboarding-driven spike caused queueing and small error bump, mitigation in place, deep-dive scheduled. No SLA breach. Owners: sophie_se (customer deep-dive), kevin_infra (pool rule), maria_cs (follow-up notes). :white_check_mark:
jonathan_ops: Thanks — marking resolved unless new alerts come in.
sophie_se: ok :thumbsup:
